text.description_html:
Schlage FC93CAMWITALD, Traditional Camelot Dummy Handleset

This Schlage made handleset has stylish square mounts outside. The Century Handleset is exemplary of quality. When you have a Schlage handleset on your front door, you know your home is secure. The Century Handleset features solid brass construction for security. Primarily used on the inactive side of double doors, this dummy handleset is just for looks and does not latch or lock.

Dummy Cylinder Handleset: Just for looks, it is used on inactive doors and does not function. Does not latch or lock.

Also available matching: Camelot Single Cylinder Handleset Grip Bottom Only

Features of the Schlage Camelot Handleset:

  • Outside Trim: Handlesets are solid forged brass; wrought brass trim rings with concealed security inserts.
  • Inside Trim: are zinc-based plated to match finishes indicated.
  • Easy installation.
  • Will fit most standard door preparations.

Specifications of the Dummy Cylinder Camelot Handleset:

  • Rage of Door Preparation: 4" to 5-1/2"
  • Exterior Total Height: 18-1/16" (with 5-1/2" door prep)
  • Exterior Total Projection: 2-15/16"
  • Exterior Center to Center Grip Range: adjustable 8-3/8" to 9-7/8"
  • Exterior Dummy Deadbolt Escutcheon Height: 3-3/8"
  • Exterior Dummy Deadbolt Escutcheon Width: 3"
  • Exterior Top Grip Escutcheon Width: 3"
  • Exterior Grip Height: 12-1/2"
  • Interior Trim: Whitney Lever with Alden Rose
  • Finish: Satin Brass
  • Schlage Camelot Exterior Handleset Specifications (PDF)

seo.description: Schlage F93 Camelot Dummy Cylinder Handleset - This Dummy Handleset is made of solid forged brass, this handleset is a fine example for the legendary quality and reliability Schlage has come to be known for. What is more, the Camelot Handleset is gorgeous, featuring beveled edged mounting plates. Since it is surface mounting, the dummy handleset is non-functional and is usually used on inactive doors as a pull or to match trim.
